item.title: Studio Briefing - Thursday, Oct 22
item.itunes:title: Studio Briefing - Thursday, Oct 22
item.description: First, the one item that needs your attention. Both Dio-Bolic pre-orders on Big Bad Toy Store still show an estimated arrival of October twenty twenty six, and October now has nine days left. That's the King Street Number One display and the Wall X D Bundle set. The Wall X D Bundle page still says it's part of the Mythic X D line and still carries a crowdfunding disclaimer. It's still worth a note to Big Bad Toy Store to confirm the arrival estimate and fix the line name. I haven't contacted anyone. Beyond that, there are no new fee, policy, or deadline changes from Etsy, Shopify,...
